## You may

- Use the Crealika name to say, truthfully, that your work is based on, works with or is a
  fork of a Crealika project, for example "based on Crealika Desktop".
- Keep the brand files unchanged in an unmodified copy of this repository and in builds made
  from it without changes.

## You may not, without written permission from Crealika

- Distribute a modified version or a fork under the Crealika name or with the Crealika logo.
  Replace the files in `brand/` and the product name first.
- Use the name or the logo in a way that suggests your product is official, or is made or
  endorsed by Crealika.
- Change the logo or use it as part of another logo.
